# Four State Custom Floors

> Custom tile installation company owned by Tim Schmit, based in Noel, Missouri. 28 years setting tile across the Four State area of Missouri, Kansas, Oklahoma and Arkansas. The owner is on every job. Not affiliated with 4 States Floor Coverings in Joplin.

- Phone: 417-825-8240 (call or text; same-day replies)
- Open every day, 8 AM to 8 PM
- Rating: 5.0 on Google (13 reviews): https://maps.app.goo.gl/QmneSirVp7D9XJJp6
- Free estimates with a written quote before any work starts
- Waterproofing: Schluter KERDI on every shower; Schluter DITRA under tile floors
- Dust-controlled demo: sealed work area, HEPA vacuums and an air scrubber vented outside
- Customers buy their own tile and flooring; pricing covers installation and setting materials
- Tile work only; no full bathroom remodels

## Services and typical pricing

- [Custom tile showers](https://www.fourstatecustomfloors.com/custom-tile-showers/): walk-in, curbless and tub-to-shower conversions, niches and benches. Most run $4,000 to $12,000 and take 7 to 14 working days.
- [Tile floors](https://www.fourstatecustomfloors.com/tile-flooring/): mosaic, porcelain, natural stone, large format and wood-look tile; heated floors. $10 to $25 per sq ft installed.
- [Kitchen backsplashes](https://www.fourstatecustomfloors.com/backsplashes/): subway, mosaic, full-height and patterned tile. $800 to $2,000, usually about 2 days.
- [LVP and hardwood](https://www.fourstatecustomfloors.com/vinyl-plank-and-hardwood/): LVP about $3 per sq ft, prefinished hardwood $4 to $6 per sq ft installed. Stairs, baseboards and quarter round.
- [Dust-controlled tile removal](https://www.fourstatecustomfloors.com/dust-free-tile-removal/): about $4 per sq ft, 1 to 2 days per room. Removal-only jobs available.

## Service area

Joplin, Webb City, Carthage, Carl Junction, Neosho, Duquesne and Noel, MO; Pittsburg and Galena, KS; Miami, Grove and Afton, OK; Bentonville, Rogers and Bella Vista, AR.
